cover.title: 5 niche ways to find out why visitors leave your pricing page

inner.title: build an exits report
inner.body: ga4's standard reports don't show exits, so open explore and add page path with the exits metric. if /pricing tops the list, you've been fixing the wrong page.

inner.title: read the scroll map
inner.body: a clarity scroll map shows what share of visitors reached each depth, and one guide puts typical pricing page depth at 55 to 70%. if your plans sit below where most people stop, they never saw the price.

inner.title: spot the feature wall
inner.body: cux describes visitors who scroll fast, then rage click feature names that aren't clickable, because they can't tell the tiers apart. a 5 column, 40 row table isn't a choice, it's homework.

inner.title: ask one exit question
inner.body: zoho suggests asking pricing page visitors if they found what they needed somewhere else, in under fifteen seconds. skip it and you're guessing between price and confusion.

inner.title: mark one plan recommended
inner.body: cux says visitors leave because the layout is confusing, not because the price is high, and its vwfs case study reports 45% more leads with no change to price. your price may be fine and the page is what loses them.

closer.HEADLINE:
the page lost them,
not the price.
